alric_intro.text: Welcome, traveler! I am Alric, the town's blacksmith. If you need a weapon forged, you've come to the right place.

alric_town.text: This town has stood for over a hundred years. The old keep to the north has been abandoned since the war, but folks say strange lights have been seen there at night.

alric_lights.text: Aye, blue-ish flickers near the old tower. The guard won't go near it. If you're brave enough to investigate, come back and tell me what you find.

alric_work.text: I could always use help at the forge. But first, prove yourself - bring me 5 iron ore from the mines east of town.

alric_quest.text: Good luck, friend. And be careful - the road to the keep is treacherous.

elsa_intro.text: Greetings. I am Elsa. The light flows through all living things, and I have learned to listen to it.

elsa_heal.text: You seem healthy enough, but should you fall in battle, seek me out. My healing salves can mend even the deepest wounds.

elsa_craft.text: I brew potions and poultices from herbs found in the surrounding woods. The silverleaf that grows near the old stream is especially potent.

brom_riddle.text:
Halt! Answer my riddle and you may pass:

I speak without a mouth and hear without ears. I have no body, but I come alive with the wind.

What am I?

brom_correct.text: Correct! You are sharper than you look. Take this - it may serve you well on your journey.

brom_wrong.text: Wrong. Come back when you've thought harder about it.
